summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with subsidiary Volato Alignment Merger Sub, LLC and Aligned, an AI infrastructure company. Under the merger, Aligned will merge into the subsidiary, becoming wholly owned by Volato; no stockholder approval required. Consideration comprises 1,000 voting and 4,000 non-voting convertible preferred shares of Volato. Post-closing, Volato will rename, CEO Matthew Liotta resigns, Christopher Ensey becomes CEO. The filing states no per-share price or premium. Watch for closing conditions and preferred stock conversion mechanics.
